description: React component for creating and configuring an MCP server via a modal form, including handling OAuth flow, validation, and form submission.

classes.name: CreateMCPServer
classes.description: React functional component for creating a new MCP server with form inputs, validation, OAuth flow, and submission handling.

methods.name: persistCreateUiState
methods.description: Saves current form and UI state to session storage for persistence across page reloads.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission, constructs payload, calls API to create MCP server, and manages UI state.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form and UI state, and closes the modal.

methods.name: handleTransportChange
methods.description: Updates transport type and resets relevant form fields.

methods.name: getAccessGroupOptions
methods.description: Generates options for access group selection, including 'create new' option.
